Performance and compatibility update for Pala's Item Clear.

### Fixed

- Lag spikes during clears on Minecraft 1.21.9 and newer: owner names for the recovery bin now come from online players and the local user cache only, never from a blocking request to Mojang's profile service.
- Items thrown by mobs (piglin bartering, villagers, allays) are no longer treated as player-owned, so `excludePlayerOwnedItems` protects only items dropped by players.
- Minecraft 1.21.5-1.21.8 now have dedicated JARs. The former `1.21.10-fabric` JAR could crash there during a clear, and the former Forge and NeoForge JARs did not load at all.
- Every JAR now loads on all the Minecraft patches of its band. Forge 1.20.2-1.20.3, 1.21 and 26.1.x, NeoForge 1.20.2-1.20.3, 1.20.5, 1.21 and 26.1.x, and Fabric 26.1.x previously had no loadable JAR.
- Faster recovery-bin deposits for large farm clears.

### Added

- Item tags in `filters.excludedItems`, for example `"#minecraft:logs"`.
- `filters.minAgeTicksOverrides` for per-item or per-tag minimum ages, for example `{"minecraft:wheat_seeds": 1200, "#minecraft:logs": 2400}`.

### Compatibility

- New artifacts: `1.21.8-fabric` and `1.21.8-neoforge` (Minecraft 1.21.5-1.21.8), `1.21.5-forge` (Forge 55), and `1.21.8-forge` (Minecraft 1.21.6-1.21.8, Forge 56-58).
- The `1.21.10-*` artifacts now cover Minecraft 1.21.9-1.21.10, including Forge 59 and NeoForge 21.9.
- Existing configuration files keep working and gain an empty `minAgeTicksOverrides` entry on the next load.

### Notes

- On Minecraft 1.20.4 NeoForge servers with vanilla clients, use NeoForge 20.4.248 or newer: earlier 20.4 builds cannot open any container for vanilla clients, including the recovery bin.
- To keep only the 30-second warning, set `"warningSeconds": [30]`; use `[]` to disable warnings.

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the full details.
